patch.description:
Flips TenantSubscriptionExempt. An exempt tenant bypasses ALL subscription
gating platform-wide (every feature unlocked, no limits) without needing a real
subscription record — for platform-owner-approved cases outside the built-in
demo/platform-owner slugs (e.g. a sponsored/service-charge pilot tenant).

source.description:
Source reports which tier of the resolution order produced this result: "plan" (the
tenant's own plan tier_limits_json), "config" (a RateLimitConfig fallback row), or
"default" (hardcoded safe floor) — callers can log/monitor this to catch misconfiguration.

min_plan_code.description:
MinPlanCode/MinPlanName/MinPlanTier name the cheapest plan that would unlock this
product, when NOT entitled — lets the UI prompt a specific upgrade rather than a
generic "upgrade your plan" message. Nil when Entitled is true or no catalogued plan
grants the product (nothing to recommend).
